{{Short description|Professor of Animal Science in the U.S.}}
Dr. '''William Tyznik''' (April 26, 1927 – May 3, 2013) was a professor of the department of Animal Science at [[Ohio State University]]<!--Wikipedians do not use "The" as part of Ohio State's name; it is considered a marketing gimmick, and routinely deleted.--> where he taught for over 40 years.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.legacy.com/obituaries/dispatch/obituary.aspx?n=william-j-tyznik&pid=164664757|title=William J. Tyznik's Obituary on The Columbus Dispatch|website=[[Legacy.com]] |publisher=}}</ref> Tyznik invented [[Frosty Paws]], a frozen treat for dogs, and [[TizWhiz]] animal feed.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tizwhizfeeds.com/index.php|title=Tizwhiz - Nutritionally there is a difference|publisher=}}</ref>

==Education==
He attended the University of Wisconsin, College of Agriculture, and received his Bachelor's (1948), Master's (1949) and Ph.D. (1951) degrees.
